snippet.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Prepare to be scared! Because SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide is OUT NOW!

How do you stop the two biggest egos of the Seven Seas from fighting? A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom.

Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick and combine their unique skills to save Bikini Bottom in their ghostliest adventure yet.
